propositions: The generic property in test_reads_under_sync_contention.py accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (missing ticket_id) on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready) when exit is zero, failing to detect truncation faults F3 and F6 that are caught by the original regression test.

The property assertion must enforce per-surface content-completeness predicates: show must carry truthy ticket_id; list/search/ready must have all elements carry truthy ticket_id, with valid-empty arrays passing via vacuous all().
Seeded faults F3 (show emits {}) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id) pass the current shape-only property but must turn both generic tests RED after the strengthening.
The change is assertion-only with no new subprocess calls, rounds, or fixtures, so wall-clock runtime is unchanged.
The modification is confined to test_reads_under_sync_contention.py; test_show_no_stall.py remains untouched.
